name: yf_sector_performance
description:
Latest prices of the 11 SPDR sector ETFs from Yahoo Finance (XLK, XLF, XLV, XLY, XLP, XLE, XLI, XLB, XLU, XLRE, XLC). Takes no inputs.
Returns: {sectors: [{sector, etf, price}]}; only the last price, no percentage change.
For returns over time use yf_multi_ticker_history with these ETFs; for index levels yf_market_summary.
Example: {}
